_description: Weights & Biases Models (W&B's core MLOps platform — runs, registered models, audit logs) → AKSI control ID mapping. Distinct from W&B Weave (LLM-ops) — W&B Models tracks model training runs, the model registry (registered models, aliases, version pins), and platform audit events. Run records are evaluated by aggregated summary_metrics (hallucination_rate, toxicity, accuracy, f1) AND by reproducibility signals (git commit pinned, git not dirty on production tag, production tag with run state, sweep flag, compute footprint). Registered-model records flag unprotected production aliases and registry sprawl. Audit-log records flag deletions, public report shares, auto-promotions to production without an approver, and identity-issuance events.

crashed.reason: Run crashed — host issue, worse than failed

killed.reason: Run killed — manual termination, surface for review

dirty_git_with_production_tag.reason: dirty working tree on a production-tagged run — un-pinned source

high_gpu_count.reason: high compute cost on a single run — surface for cost review

unprotected_production_alias.reason: model with latest_alias=production but is_protected=false — production model without protection rule

version_count_sprawl.reason: production model with version_count above threshold — registry sprawl

artifact.delete.reason: FAIL when target was referenced by a Production model; otherwise FLAG

model.alias.set.reason: FAIL when promoting to production-protected without approval; PASS when approved

model.alias.remove.reason: Alias removed from registered model — registry mutation

report.shared_publicly.reason: Report shared publicly — potential sensitive data exposure (run charts may contain customer values)

api_key.created.reason: API key issued — surface for identity governance

service_account.created.reason: Service account created — surface for identity governance

team.member.added.reason: Team member added — review for least-privilege
